evidence: Modifies src/wallet/test/coinselector_tests.cpp to test coin selection result merging behavior.
rationale: Adds unit test coverage to ensure SelectionResult::Merge preserves algorithm metadata when combining manual preset inputs and automatic coin selection results. While it successfully kills a surviving mutant in coin selection metadata reporting, it does not modify production code or fix a user-facing issue, making it a marginal improvement in wallet review priority.
